Semaphore design: Define a mutual exclusion semaphore array ⟦MC_40cd896763dbf564_0⟧ to implement mutually exclusive access to the 5 chopsticks.
Number the philosophers from 0 to 4; the chopstick to the left of philosopher ⟦MC_873f49f1cf667b4a_0⟧ is numbered ⟦MC_873f49f1cf667b4a_1⟧, and the chopstick to the right is numbered ⟦MC_3c9be953a4f605a9_0⟧.
